title: AnalysisTrace
description: The recorded trace of one stored analysis: every tool call the model made, in the order it asked for them, and everything it said through report_progress. Returned by analysis.trace on demand rather than carried on AnalysisView, because a run may make five hundred calls and the view is re-sent on every read and every grouping switch.

analysisId.description: The analysis this trace belongs to.

toolCalls.description: Every tool call, ordered by ordinal. Complete, unlike the live log, which keeps only its most recent rows.

progressMessages.description: What the model said about what it was doing, in its own words and in order. Run data, not UI copy.

ordinal.description: Position in the run, from 1. Calls made concurrently in one turn are numbered in the order the model asked for them.

turn.description: Which round trip to the provider asked for it.

argumentsPreview.description: The arguments the model passed, truncated to 200 characters. Enough to tell two calls apart.

resultPreview.description: The beginning of what the tool returned, truncated to 500 characters. The full result is not retained.

resultBytes.description: Size of the full result in UTF-8 bytes — what was handed back to the model, not the preview.

durationMs.description: How long the call took, in milliseconds.

isError.description: True when the tool refused or failed. Information, not an alarm: the model corrects a failed call.
